description: This file contains functions and types for converting and processing messages between different formats, handling assistant responses, tool calls, reasoning items, and message content parsing within an AI chat system.

classes.name: ReplayModelInfo
classes.description: Type representing optional input array for model override.

classes.name: AssistantMessageWithPhase
classes.description: Type extending AssistantMessage with optional phase property.

methods.name: toNonEmptyString
methods.description: Converts a value to a trimmed non-empty string or null.

methods.name: normalizeAssistantPhase
methods.description: Normalizes a value to specific assistant phases ('commentary' or 'final_answer').

methods.name: encodeAssistantTextSignature
methods.description: Encodes assistant message signature with id and optional phase into JSON string.

methods.name: parseAssistantTextSignature
methods.description: Parses a string to extract assistant message signature details.

methods.name: supportsImageInput
methods.description: Determines if image input is supported based on model override.

methods.name: contentToText
methods.description: Extracts concatenated text from content parts or string.

methods.name: contentToOpenAIParts
methods.description: Converts content into OpenAI-compatible parts, supporting images if enabled.

methods.name: isReplayableReasoningType
methods.description: Checks if a value is a reasoning type string.

methods.name: toReplayableReasoningId
methods.description: Converts a value to a reasoning ID if it starts with 'rs_'.

methods.name: toReasoningSignature
methods.description: Creates a reasoning signature object from a value.

methods.name: encodeThinkingSignature
methods.description: Encodes reasoning signature into JSON string.

methods.name: parseReasoningItem
methods.description: Parses a reasoning item from a value.

methods.name: parseThinkingSignature
methods.description: Parses reasoning signature string into reasoning item.

methods.name: encodeToolCallReplayId
methods.description: Encodes tool call ID and optional item ID into string.

methods.name: decodeToolCallReplayId
methods.description: Decodes string into call ID and optional item ID.

methods.name: extractReasoningSummaryText
methods.description: Extracts and concatenates reasoning summary text from various formats.

methods.name: extractResponseReasoningText
methods.description: Extracts reasoning text from response items.

methods.name: convertTools
methods.description: Converts context tools into function tool definitions.

methods.name: planTurnInput
methods.description: Determines the next turn input mode and items based on context and previous response.

methods.name: convertMessagesToInputItems
methods.description: Converts message array into input items for processing.

methods.name: buildAssistantMessageFromResponse
methods.description: Builds an assistant message object from a response, including handling of tool calls and reasoning.
